paper.abstract_en: A formula for the $α$-K-energy functional for the Kähler-Yang-Mills (KYM) equations is provided in this paper. Using this formula and Chen's $ε$-geodesic equation on the space of Kähler potentials, we prove that if a solution exists to the KYM equations for a simple vector bundle on a Kähler manifold with discrete automorphism group, then it is unique and the $α$-K-energy is bounded from below. Inspired by the study of constant scalar curvature Kähler metrics, we introduce a coupled J-equation to study the $α$-K energy functional.
